errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.conflict: This changed since you loaded it. Reload and try again.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.server: The server could not complete the request.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the email address your workspace knows.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Then create a workspace, or accept an invitation.
signUp.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters, and avoid a password close to your email address.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

workspaces.title: Your workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Choose a workspace to work in.

empty.title: No workspace yet
empty.description: Create a workspace to start handling tickets. An invitation grants access to an existing workspace instead.

workspaces.createDescription: You become its owner and can invite people afterwards.

notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.description: It may have been archived, or your access may have been removed.

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.description: Tickets your team creates, and anything your customers send, will appear here.

filteredEmpty.title: No tickets match these filters
filteredEmpty.description: Try a different status, priority or assignee, or clear the filters.

create.title: New ticket
create.description: Record a request. It starts open and unassigned.

detail.conflict: This ticket changed since you loaded it. Reload it and apply your change again — your unsent message is kept.

controls.title: Fields and assignment
controls.readOnly: Your role ({{role}}) can read this ticket but not change it.

visibility.internalNoteHint: Only your team can see this.

refusals.transition: That status change is not allowed from the current state.
refusals.assignee: That person cannot be assigned this ticket.

composer.title: Write
composer.chooseVisibility: Choose whether this is a reply the requester sees or a note for your team.

timeline.title: Conversation
timeline.truncated: Showing the oldest messages only; this ticket has more than one page of them.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: Replies and internal notes on this ticket will appear here.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Everyone in this workspace, and the invitations that are still outstanding.
members.readOnly: You are a {{role}} here, so you can see the members but not change them.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: They join with the role you choose once they accept the link you share.
invite.linkDescription: This is shown once. Anyone who opens it joins as {{role}} until it expires.

transfer.title: Hand over ownership
transfer.description: {{email}} becomes the owner of this workspace, and you become an admin.

refusals.capability: Your role in this workspace does not allow this change.
refusals.lastOwner: A workspace must keep at least one active owner. Hand ownership to someone else first.
refusals.targetInactive: Only an active member can become the owner.
refusals.duplicateInvitation: An invitation for this address is already pending. Resend or revoke it instead.
refusals.notPending: This invitation is no longer pending.

invitations.title: Workspace invitation
invitations.offer: You are invited to join {{workspace}} as {{role}}.
invitations.requiresSignIn: Sign in or create an account with the invited email address to accept.
invitations.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {{email}}, which is not the invited address. Sign in with the invited address to accept.

invalid.title: This invitation cannot be used
invalid.notFound: The link is not valid. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invalid.expired: This invitation expired. Ask a workspace admin to resend it.
invalid.revoked: This invitation was revoked. Ask a workspace admin for a new one.
invalid.accepted: This invitation was already accepted. Sign in to open the workspace.
